submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 10 (Ge0.34Mn0.66, close to the Mn2GeO4 stoichiometry) gave the highest photocurrent: 1.5e-7 A. The Mn-rich point (Ge0.13) and the Ge0.44 point were both lower, so the best value lies near Ge≈0.3–0.35.
